priorities.finding: Retain request-context features (tab, hour, weekday). Training-only temporal screening shows the only positive candidate lift (+0.00221) with positive lift on all four reported days and full coverage; the resulting official-validation model reaches GAUC 0.6670 and nDCG@5 0.5358.
priorities.recommended_action: Stop broad feature expansion and keep the leakage-safe request-context block as the selected increment. Allocate any remaining budget only to a tightly scoped, temporally validated treatment of weak request-context values rather than adding screened-out feature groups.

priorities.finding: Tab performance is the material ranking risk. Tab 0 is large (13,726 rows) and has both weak within-user ranking (GAUC 0.5516) and very weak top-five retrieval (nDCG@5 0.0624). Tab 6 is also sizeable (5,170 rows) with GAUC 0.5989 and nDCG@5 0.1054. Tab 8 is worse but smaller (547 rows), with GAUC 0.2778 and nDCG@5 0.0255.
priorities.recommended_action: If one additional experiment is permitted, test a leakage-safe tab-specific regularization/calibration or tab-by-hour interaction with predeclared temporal-holdout success criteria: no global primary regression and improvement in both GAUC and nDCG@5 for tab 0 and tab 6. Do not infer that the tab feature itself caused these slice weaknesses; these are post-score diagnostics.

priorities.finding: Hours 3 and 4 have weak top-five ranking and weak GAUC relative to global performance: hour 3 has GAUC 0.5318 and nDCG@5 0.3871; hour 4 has GAUC 0.5446 and nDCG@5 0.3734. This supports diagnosing a genuine ranking weakness rather than relying on GAUC alone.
priorities.recommended_action: Include hours 3 and 4 as guardrail slices in the single permitted context-treatment experiment, but do not launch a separate hour-only feature search under the strict stopping rule.

metric_diagnosis: The selected model has credible global within-user ranking evidence (GAUC 0.6670), but its top-five quality is materially lower (nDCG@5 0.5358), so GAUC alone would mask retrieval failures. The most important weakness is tab 0, where both GAUC and nDCG@5 are poor at meaningful volume, establishing a ranking and top-five problem. Some low-GAUC small tabs can still show high nDCG@5, illustrating why the two metrics must be interpreted jointly and with sample size. Given that request_context is the sole positive, stable training-only screen result and all other candidate groups were rejected, the strict early-stopping decision is to retain the current block and permit at most one pre-registered context-slice remediation experiment.
